The '''Stellar Mag V Mining Vessel''' was manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. The ''[[Sinking Stone]]'' was an example of such a vessel during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="EJ" />
